description: When and how fast sequences send: time zone, days, hours, daily limits, and whether sending is on at all. Fields left out keep their value. Turning it on lets running sequences send: that first call returns the schedule and needs confirm: true, and the first time it also needs the time zone. Needs LinkedIn connected.

activeDays.description: Days sending is allowed: 0 Sunday to 6 Saturday

confirm.description: Set to true only after the user agreed to what the first call (without it) said would happen.

name: update_sending_settings
title: Set the sending schedule
